description: Machine mirror of 0-poetics-boot-hollow (Load Order, Module Registry, Plugin Registry) and the README's hard dependencies and minimal sets by task. The boot stays the human-readable inventory; `dr lint` checks this file against it and against the files on disk.

load_steps.3: slot registry, when slot status is in question
load_steps.4: device and catalog extensions the task requires
load_steps.6: style and workshop modes, which ride a voice
load_steps.7: full monty plugins, only when source-bearing calibration is needed

0-poetics-boot-hollow.role: Loader wrapper: load order, module registry, plugin registry, Outstanding and Closed lists, Default State

0a-portable-poetics-kernel.role: Kernel: register, reading procedures, checkpoints, directives, designation and source policy, output formats, bay contracts, found text, Poetics Scan

0c-voice-designations.role: Designation set, leak tiers, calibration-collision rule, take versus specimen
0c-voice-designations.note: Load before any voice module. Without it every voice labels its output with its calibration source's name.

0b-voice-slot-registry.role: Slot matrix, voice test, candidate log, reopen conditions

0d-apparatus-provenance.role: History and rationale. Loaded by nothing

voice-volitional-map.role: The five voices' aims, completion tests, and failures in one table. Never loaded

7-device-inventory-extended.role: 192 devices in Categories A to G, Hermetic re-sort (H), training corpus (I), specimen clusters (J), Scan Mode (K). Replaces the kernel's lite inventory while loaded

7a-nom-function-battery.role: Five function-level tests built from the inventory's Nom and English-simulation entries

8-frye-extraction.role: Radical of presentation, paired fallacy guards, melos and opsis separation. Default for any specimen whose kind is not poem

9-casanova-extraction.role: Seven tools and one directive on a work's position in international literary space

10-monadology-foundations.role: Leibniz foundations for three house disciplines. Fires nothing

12-confinement-inventory.role: Confinement catalog; hard dependency of the workshop's Confinement Bay

13-speaker-dials.role: Speaker dial catalog: nine dials, four checks, trial forms, eleven experiments

14-attridge-staten-extraction.role: Fourteen reading operations with a refusal ledger. Fires on warrant

compartmentalization-engine.role: An engine type and a constrained opt-in lens for a poem built around a wound it walls off

1-rother-voice-module.role: ASSAY voice; holds the default verdict slot

5-hersh-voice-module.role: DATUM voice; reads a specimen's account of itself against a record

4-gonzo-mode.role: VISE style mode; rides any voice

3a-workshop.role: JIG workshop mode, with found-text treatment and named contrast trials

full-monty-snowcrust-example.role: Floor-origin hypothesis and accidental ars poetica

full-monty-santos-small-branch.role: Sayability, seam pressure, and appropriation risk

full-monty-jeffers-hellenistics-plugin.role: Anti-laundering engine default and transparent ugliness

full-monty-gilson-coscienza-plugin.role: Source-bearing Coscienza calibration from a critic's book, with added directives. 7a and the Compartmentalization Engine use its Critic's Projection Error directive when loaded

ASSAY.fires: A work is valued above or below what its inheritance earns

PLUMB.fires: A system hides its cost and there's ground to stand on
PLUMB.silent: No ground, or the subject sits above the body

TARE.fires: Cost is laundered or a reader is gated
TARE.silent: A difficult poem earns its difficulty

RETICLE.fires: A procedure is present and misnamed as noise
RETICLE.silent: The force is narrative, bodily, or vernacular

DATUM.fires: An official account and a record both exist
DATUM.silent: Either is missing, or interpretation was asked for

devices.note: device-level naming; Scan Mode; workshop; device names for 13

found-text.note: default for any specimen whose kind is not poem
